DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH) due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency.

The presence of ambiguous genitalia at birth (partial labial fusion, clitoromegaly) alongside hirsutism, severe acne, and primary amenorrhea strongly suggests a form of Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia. I will request an ACTH stimulation test and 17-hydroxyprogesterone levels to confirm this.
